newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil mixed at close as buyers retreat.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil mixed at close as buyers retreat.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended mixed as buyers retreated and some selling appeared. Some refiner buying and an Egyptian tender helped prices rise earlier. Trading was volatile but the near-term looks uncertain with players waiting for Egypt's buying. June futures seen trading in 1,250-1,265 range.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures. Interest mainly in crude palm oil.
Other positions were quiet except for third month June futures which met some liquidation towards the close.
The contract closed one ringgit down at 1,256 ringgit ($506.86) a tonne.
"It looks like the market couldn't hold firm at (1,260) and some liquidation appeared," another trader said.

"Chartwise, we will see some uncertainty in the June futures contract tomorrow if there are no supportive news and lack of purchases from Egypt," a chartist said. "The trading range will be between 1,250 and 1,265 for June futures."
Egypt is tendering to buy 10,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil for May arrival.
Among physicals, April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,297.50 ringgit against bids of 1,292.50, after trading at 1,300 and 1,295.
April (central) saw offers at 1,290 against bids of 1,285.
May (south) was offered at 1,290 and bids at 1,285, and May (central) at 1,282.50 against 1,277.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $542.50, June at $540 and July/Aug/Sep at $535. May was traded at $540.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $582.50, May at $580, Jun at $575 and July/Aug/Sep at $570. Apr was traded at $585 and $582.50, and May at $580 and $581.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $297.50.
